alex: Morning — quick ask: we need to reshuffle the RFC review roster for Thursday's 10:30 PT session. Two authors (Priya and Marcos) just flagged a conflict. Can folks swap or cover pre-read notes? :wave:

brie: I can swap my slot with Priya if that helps. I prefer later in the day though (2pm PT) — does that break anything?

chun: 2pm is fine from infra's side, but I'm on reviewer duty for the 10:30 route. If Brie moves, can someone else pick the 10:30 reviewer slot?

elaine: tagging @sam — can you take the 10:30 reviewer spot? I've got a calendar block that afternoon. Also reminder: link to the pre-reads is here https://docs.internal/rfcs/rfc-401-pre-read (please add comments inline).

sam: I can cover 10:30 reviewer. I'll finish the pre-read and a short comment thread by EOD today. :thumbsup:

alex: Great — summary so far: Brie -> Priya's author slot moved to 2pm PT; Sam covers 10:30 reviewer. Need someone to scrub the agenda order (we had 6 items, might condense). Can someone update the agenda and post the final order here?

brie: I'll scrub it and post an updated order in ~30m. Quick question — are we keeping the live demo at the top or moving it to the end? Demo takes ~8–10 mins but needs lavendar-lab infra up.

chun: Put the demo at the end. If infra is spotty, we can skip without blocking discussion.

brie: ok doing that. Draft agenda: ```1) Quick updates (5m)
2) RFC 401 (Brie -> 2pm) (15m)
3) RFC 412 (Marcos) (15m)
4) Design follow-ups (10m)
5) Live demo (lavendar-lab) (10m) -> last, optional
6) AOB (5m)```

elaine: Looks good. Can you also add a TL;DR comment under each RFC in the pre-read doc so reviewers can skim?

brie: will add TL;DRs now.

rfc-bot: Automated reminder: Pre-read comments due 24 hours before meeting. Please mark items you want on the live agenda with `@agenda` in the doc.

alex: Thanks everyone. Final action items: Sam -> reviewer 10:30, Brie -> author swap + TL;DRs, Brie -> post final agenda, everyone -> add inline pre-read comments. I'll update calendar invites after Brie posts the agenda. :sparkles:
